biggest_catch: The friend must open their account at a branch with your coupon (or name you online) - if they open without crediting you, you get nothing.
catches: Referring member receives $50 deposited directly into their share account within 7-10 business days of the new account opening.
Limit 10 referrals per calendar year, not exceeding $500.
Friend must open their first account with Ocean Financial; complete the Refer a Friend coupon and have the friend bring it to a branch, or have them provide your name when opening online.
Membership eligibility required; limit one incentive offer per member/account; cannot be combined with other offers.
Offers not valid for new youth accounts; referrer must be a current Ocean Financial member 18+.
Rewards are considered interest and may be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT (or 1042-S).

steps: Complete your portion of the Ocean Financial Refer a Friend coupon.
Give the coupon to your friend.
Friend brings the coupon to an Ocean Financial branch (or provides your name when opening online) and opens a new member share account.
You receive $50 in your share account within 7-10 business days (up to 10/$500 per year).
